chapter: Childhood and first bands in Ohio
title: His mother's and father's family origins
summary: His mother came from London, Ohio, daughter of a horse trader; his father came from Danville, Kentucky.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Where was your mother from, Quen?
She was born in London, Ohio. Oh, maybe the town is about maybe 14 or 15 miles from Springfield going towards Columbus, that way. Just a very little town.
And her father was a horse trader in that town.
My dad came from Danville, Kentucky.
